articles.title: Bitcoin open interest jumps $2.3 billion as traders pay more for bullish positions
articles.snippet: Rising open interest and funding rates signal renewed demand for bullish bitcoin exposure.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $86,000 ahead of U.S. jobs report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is up roughly 3% in October as traders await September’s jobs data, while rising bond yields, a stronger dollar weigh on broader markets.

articles.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds
articles.snippet: The regulator issued a proposed rule for custody, marking a swan song for its inaugural Crypto Task Force chief, Commissioner Hester Peirce, who exits this week.

articles.title: Another Trump memecoin dinner advertised for token's top investors
articles.snippet: The company managing the memecoin calls the November event the "most exclusive dinner in the world."

articles.title: NEAR Intents hit by $3.8 million exploit as crypto's rough year of hacks continues
articles.snippet: The popular cross-chain trading system said Friday the exploiter returned all stolen assets a day later a bug affected deposits and withdrawals across several networks.
